message.content: In the conversation regarding the community garden renovation, Li Hua presents several thoughtful suggestions to Adam Smith. Initially, she proposes adding more seating areas to make the garden more inviting and comfortable for visitors. She also suggests incorporating flower beds with native plants, which would not only enhance the aesthetic appeal but also support local wildlife by attracting butterflies and bees. Li Hua specifically recommends lavender and coneflowers, noting that these flowers are both visually appealing and require minimal maintenance. Additionally, she mentions the inclusion of a small herb section, suggesting basil, mint, and rosemary, which would provide fresh herbs for visitors to use in their cooking. These suggestions demonstrate Li Hua's keen eye for enhancing the functionality and enjoyment of the community garden.
